subject: Pilot credits for State University DH Lab - request and coordination
message_1:
From: Prof. Lina Gomez <l.gomez@stateuniv.edu>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: dh-lab@stateuniv.edu
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot credits + trial extension for DH Lab

Hi Marcus and Ben,

I lead the Digital Humanities Lab at State University. We're preparing a small pilot to add large-language-model assisted transcription and named-entity linking to an archival newspaper corpus (approx. 2.5M pages). The student team estimates ~500k tokens/month during the 6-month pilot.

We applied for the standard education trial but ran into the promo cap. Would Redwood be open to providing additional credits (or a trial extension) for this research project? Our goals are:
- Produce reproducible annotation workflows for historical OCR correction
- Evaluate privacy-preserving hosting options (we may need a VPC later)
- Publish a short technical note and attribution to Redwood if the pilot results are accepted

Attached is a short pilot scope (pilot_scope.pdf) and a note from our grants office on institutional approval.

Practical questions:
1) What documentation do you need to qualify us for a top-up promo?
2) Can we get a 6-month trial extension starting Nov 1?
3) Any constraints on model variants / data residency we should know about for academic datasets?

Thanks — we can be flexible on timing. Happy to jump on a 30-min call this week.

Best,
Lina Gomez
Professor of Digital Humanities
State University
Attachment: pilot_scope.pdf (PDF, 312KB)

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the scope. Really exciting use case.

Quick answers up front: we can usually accommodate a six-month education pilot extension and a one-time credit top-up for academic research; the exact size depends on expected token volume and existing promo caps. From an operational standpoint we'll need:
- Institutional verification (email from purchasing or a signed letter on university letterhead)
- A short SOW or one-page statement of work with estimated monthly usage (your pilot_scope.pdf helps a lot)
- A point of contact for billing/purchasing if a PO is needed

I've attached our edu-eligibility checklist (edu-eligibility-checklist.pdf) — it lists the minimum items procurement typically requests. Ben, can you size a recommended credit allocation based on Lina's 500k tokens/month estimate and advise whether we should do a straight credits grant or a time-limited promo plus discounted rate after credits?

Lina — if you can get a short note from purchasing (purchasing@stateuniv.edu) and confirm the start date (you mentioned Nov 1), I'll fast-track this with our grants approvals. I can also set up a quick technical onboarding call next week with our solutions engineer.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
